name: ARK public autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens()
summary: ARK.autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() can be called by anyone to burn ARK held by the ARK/WBNB pair and sync it, so the attacker repeatedly shrank the pool and sold into the inflated price.
